content:
Apple TV just added a large batch of 15 classic movies to its library, available for subscribers to watch for free. Here's the full list.

Apple TV adds 15 classic movies for users to stream

Apple TV has always focused on original series and movies, rarely licensing content into its library. But last month, Apple surprisingly added several classic films, including Three Days of the Condor, E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial, and Beverly Hills Cop.

And today, Apple adds another 15 brand-new classic movies to the service.

Here's the complete list of newly added movies:

  • The Social Network
  • Mad Max: Fury Road
  • School of Rock
  • Her
  • Ferris Bueller's Day Off
  • Superbad
  • Mamma Mia! The Movie
  • Don't Really Care
  • Life Destroyed by Me
  • In the Heart of the Sea
  • A League of Their Own
  • Troy
  • The Insider
  • Zero Dark Thirty
  • The Wolf of Wall Street

As with last month's movie lineup, availability depends on your region. The 15 films above are available to viewers in the United States.

The only bad news is that Apple has also removed quite a few movies that were streaming last month. Although a small portion remains, most are no longer available to watch.

It is currently unclear whether these latest movies will likewise only be available for a limited time. If there's a title you have your eye on, you may want to watch it soon.

September will also see more Apple original series and movies debut — check out the full preview below.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, or you can get a discount through the Apple One bundle.
